reasons: Aggregation differs: the Datadog query uses avg across the scoped series, but the candidate uses sum(rate(...)), which totals across series and changes the value by the series count.
Quantity and unit are plausibly the same: postgresql.tup_updated is a monotonic sum of updated rows, and rate() yields rows per second, matching the widget title.
Grouping is ok: neither side has a group-by, so both produce one overall series.
Outcome is ok: an OTel counterpart exists, so translating rather than blocking is correct.
Fix: the Datadog avg should map to avg() over the rate series, not sum(). Also confirm the Datadog postgresql.rows_updated value is already a per-second rate before applying rate() again.
